# Tomás Campoy Rojo

Tomás Campoy Rojo is a Data Engineer in Spain focused on data platforms, cloud architecture, AI systems, automation, performance and reliability. His current professional role is at Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia (UCAM).

Primary topics: data engineering, data platforms, AI systems, agent infrastructure, context engineering, retrieval, model routing, MCP, durable workflows, computer use, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, dbt, Polars, SQL, lakehouse architecture, streaming data, data quality, observability and system reliability.

GitHub: https://github.com/tomcrojo
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/tomcrojo/
